skills.name: Dream Analysis
skills.description: Interpret dreams to identify underlying desires and themes.
deliverables: Maintain a dream journal for 30 days
Write a summary report linking themes to potential skills

skills.name: Skill Mapping
skills.description: Convert dream themes into concrete, learnable skills.
deliverables: For each skill, define a clear outcome (e.g., 'able to build a website')
Prioritize skills based on interest and feasibility

skills.name: Learning Plan Design
skills.description: Create a structured learning path for each skill.
deliverables: For each skill, a step-by-step learning plan with resources

skills.name: Practice Schedule
skills.description: Establish a consistent routine for practicing skills.
deliverables: Weekly schedule with dedicated practice blocks
Plan for handling obstacles (e.g., time constraints)

skills.name: Progress Tracking
skills.description: Monitor and record progress towards skill mastery.
deliverables: Choose a tracking tool (e.g., spreadsheet, app)

skills.name: Review and Adjustment
skills.description: Regularly evaluate the plan and make necessary changes.
deliverables: Criteria for adjusting goals or methods

success_metrics.target: 100% of milestones within 2 weeks of target
At least one concrete artifact per skill (e.g., project, presentation)

resources.time: 2-3 hours per week for practice, plus 30 minutes for journaling and review
resources.budget: Low (mostly free online resources, may include books or courses)
resources.mentors: Optional: seek feedback from experts in desired skill areas
